Hi Jared — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's call and suggested next steps so we're all aligned:

- What we heard: Acme is testing Redwood for summarization + routing in two high-volume message flows (Triage and Admin Notifications).
- Current pilot scope: 2 models (gpt-redwood-8k + cheaper 4k variant) across two environments.
- Pilot credits issued: $10k starting June 1st; current spend looks uneven across flows.

Action items and asks:
1) Can you confirm current burn-rate (tokens/day) and top-3 endpoints by volume? I took a first pass from telemetry but want your numbers to qualify next steps for an extension.
2) Please share budget range for production (target $/1M tokens) — helps us recommend batching/quantization.
3) If you need more pilot credits to finish evaluation, tell us target duration and estimated tokens to cover that period.

I've attached a short summary of today's notes and an exported pilot usage CSV.

Thanks — happy to sync again later this week.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — good call. Quick answers below:

- Burn rate: ~1.8M tokens/day across both flows (Triage ~1.2M, Admin ~0.6M). Peak days hit ~2.4M.
- Top endpoints: /summarize-thread (60%), /classify-priority (25%), /auto-ack (15%).
- Current pilot budget: we were given an internal cap of ~$25k for proof-of-concept (we've used ~40% so far). For production we are looking at $700–900 per 1M tokens as a ballpark target given latency needs.

Extension ask: If Redwood can provide an additional $8k in credits to cover the rest of June into mid-July, we can complete the test matrix (latency/load + failure modes). That would roughly cover ~10–12M tokens.

Let me know if you need any additional details from infra.

— Jared

- They are sensitive to unit economics: targeting $700–900 per 1M tokens. Our Recommend: offer targeted credits + Optimize consult to reduce $/1M via batching and quantization.

1) Rishi: approve $8k extension from pilot credits (sales-led credit approval).
2) Monica: deploy a short Optimize session (1-2 days) to identify batching and model variant savings; include a recommended config that keeps latency under 350ms p95.
3) Vivek: confirm we can provide a one-off pricing note for the account (no contract change yet) and confirm SLA implications.

If approved I will send Jared a formal extension note and DocuSign link to accept the credits and updated pilot window.
